# The theme reference

A theme is **data, not code**: a TOML file a consumer versions and diffs
without importing drawspec. It owns every appearance decision — type size,
stroke weight, shape per role, the canvas width — so that no document has to,
and so that changing one changes every diagram at once.

Every theme declares `version = 1`, and that is the one key not
inherited: a file must state which format it was written against, or a future
v2 would load as a v1. Everything else is **merged over the bundled default**,
leaf by leaf, so a theme declares only what it changes. The values in the
*Default* columns below are therefore what a key holds if a theme is silent
about it — they are read from the bundled `default.toml`, not from the code's
own fallbacks.

```toml
version = 1
name = "house"

[scale]
body = 12.0        # everything else keeps the default
```

`drawspec theme check house.toml` loads it and runs its invariants.
[The guide](guide.md#writing-a-theme) walks through writing one.

## The greyscale invariant

Two roles may not be distinguishable **by colour alone**. The loader compares
every pair and refuses the theme if a pair differs in no other channel, which
is why the tables below carry `shape`, `dash`, `fill_pattern` and
`stroke_width` beside `stroke`: those are what has to do the work. A diagram
that loses its meaning in a black-and-white printout is a diagram that lost it
in dark mode too, and neither is caught by looking at the screen it was made
on.

Colour is not forbidden — the bundled `accent` theme uses it. It may *point*,
and it may never *carry*.

## Sections

### `[canvas]`

The one width every diagram is drawn to, and the legibility floor.

| Key | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `width` | `640.0` | The canvas every diagram is drawn to, in user units. |
| `width_mode` | `"fixed"` | Whether a drawing narrower than `width` keeps the canvas or is cropped to it. One of `fixed`, `ink`. |
| `min_legible_size` | `9.0` | The floor the fit band may not push type below. |
| `caption` | `"below"` | Where a document's `caption` sits: `below` the drawing, or `above` it. |
| `ink` | `"#1a1a1a"` | What `currentColor` resolves to in the `standalone` profile. |

### `[font]`

The families to measure and to name in the output, in preference order.

| Key | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `sans` | `["DejaVu Sans", "sans-serif"]` | The families measured for ordinary text, in preference order. |
| `serif` | `["DejaVu Serif", "serif"]` | The families for the serif role, in preference order. |
| `mono` | `["DejaVu Sans Mono", "monospace"]` | The families for `code` spans, in preference order. |
| `default` | `"sans"` | Which of the three roles text takes when it asks for none. One of `sans`, `serif`, `mono`. |

### `[scale]`

One size per level. There is no API for scaling a single level.

| Key | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `title` | `15.0` | The diagram's own title. |
| `heading` | `13.0` | A box's heading — the first line of a node that has more than one. |
| `body` | `11.0` | Ordinary text inside a box. The size a diagram is mostly read at. |
| `label` | `10.0` | Edge labels, axis ticks, and the asides beside an entry. |

### `[fit]`

How far the whole type scale may stretch to make a document fit.

| Key | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `scale_min` | `0.85` | How far the whole scale may shrink. One factor, applied to all four levels. |
| `scale_max` | `1.0` | How far it may grow. `1.0` means shrink to fit, never grow. |

### `[box]`

Box geometry constants: margin, line spacing, corner treatment.

| Key | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `padding` | `[10.0, 12.0, 12.0, 12.0]` | Space between a box's text and its border, as `[top, right, bottom, left]`. |
| `line_height` | `1.35` | Baseline-to-baseline distance, as a multiple of the type size. |
| `corner_radius` | `4.0` | Corner rounding for a `rect`. Zero draws square corners. |
| `lead` | `"bold"` | How the first paragraph of a label with more than one is set. |
| `widen_steps` | `1` | How far past the aspect floor a box may keep taking width to shed a line. |

### `[edge]`

Line constants shared by every edge role.

| Key | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `stroke_width` | `1.5` | The default line weight. An edge role may override it. |
| `min_shaft_length` | `16.0` | The shortest visible run of line an arrow may have. |
| `head_length` | `8.0` | How long an arrow head is drawn, before it is scaled to its own shaft. |
| `clearance` | `6.0` | Daylight a route keeps from every box it is not joined to. |
| `lane_spacing` | `12.0` | How far apart two routes running along the same line are drawn. |

### `[mark]`

How a chart tells one mark from another, and how much room bars get.

| Key | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `fills` | `["dots", "hatch", "grid", "cross", "none"]` | The fills a chart's marks take, in order, one per filled mark. Each one of `none`, `solid`, `hatch`, `dots`, `cross`, `grid`. |
| `colours` | `[]` | A colour per fill, in the same order, or empty for ink alone. |
| `gap` | `0.3` | How much of a category's band is left empty around its bars, as a fraction. Zero draws bars that touch, which reads as one wide bar. |

### `[title]`

Whether a diagram carries its own title. Off until the question is settled.

| Key | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `show` | `false` | Whether a document's `title` is drawn on the diagram as well as announced to a screen reader. Off by default: a figure caption is usually the page's job, not the drawing's. |
| `level` | `"title"` | Which type level the drawn title takes. One of `title`, `heading`, `body`, `label`. |

### `[cycle]`

How a `cycle`'s connectors are drawn. Appearance, so it lives here.

| Key | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `connector` | `"arc"` | Whether a cycle's steps are joined by a thin arc or a broad tapered band. One of `arc`, `band`. |
| `width` | `11.0` | How thick a `band` connector is at its shaft, in user units. |

### `[funnel]`

Which way a `funnel` tapers. Appearance, so it lives here.

| Key | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `direction` | `"down"` | `down` tapers towards the bottom of the page; `right`, towards its edge. One of `down`, `right`. |

## `[role.*]` — the node roles

A document names a role; the theme decides what that role looks like. The
vocabulary is closed: `start`, `step`, `decision`, `terminal`, `emphasis`, `note`, `group`. `shape` is one of
`rect`, `pill`, `diamond`, `ellipse`, `none` and `fill_pattern` one of `none`, `solid`, `hatch`, `dots`, `cross`, `grid`.

| Role | `shape` | `stroke` | `fill` | `fill_pattern` | `dash` | `stroke_width` |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `start` | `"pill"` | `"currentColor"` | `"none"` | `"none"` | `"none"` | `1.5` |
| `step` | `"rect"` | `"currentColor"` | `"none"` | `"none"` | `"none"` | `1.5` |
| `decision` | `"diamond"` | `"currentColor"` | `"none"` | `"none"` | `"none"` | `1.5` |
| `terminal` | `"pill"` | `"currentColor"` | `"none"` | `"none"` | `"none"` | `2.5` |
| `emphasis` | `"rect"` | `"currentColor"` | `"none"` | `"none"` | `"none"` | `2.5` |
| `note` | `"none"` | `"currentColor"` | `"none"` | `"none"` | `"3 2"` | `1.0` |
| `group` | `"rect"` | `"currentColor"` | `"none"` | `"none"` | `"6 3"` | `1.0` |

## `[edge_role.*]` — the edge roles

The same arrangement for connectors, and it is where a connector that is *not*
an arrow lives: an author says two things are merely associated (`link`) and
the theme decides that means a line with no head. `head` and `tail` are each
one of `arrow`, `open`, `diamond`, `circle`, `bar`, `none`.

| Role | `head` | `tail` | `stroke` | `dash` | `stroke_width` | `routing` |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `flow` | `"arrow"` | `"none"` | `"currentColor"` | `"none"` | `1.5` | `"orthogonal"` |
| `link` | `"none"` | `"none"` | `"currentColor"` | `"none"` | `1.0` | `"direct"` |
| `exchange` | `"arrow"` | `"arrow"` | `"currentColor"` | `"none"` | `1.5` | `"orthogonal"` |
| `weak` | `"open"` | `"none"` | `"currentColor"` | `"4 3"` | `1.5` | `"orthogonal"` |
| `owns` | `"diamond"` | `"none"` | `"currentColor"` | `"none"` | `1.5` | `"orthogonal"` |
| `strong` | `"arrow"` | `"none"` | `"currentColor"` | `"none"` | `2.5` | `"orthogonal"` |
| `aside` | `"none"` | `"none"` | `"currentColor"` | `"4 3"` | `1.0` | `"orthogonal"` |

## The bundled themes

| Theme | What it is for |
|---|---|
| `default` | Ink only. Every stroke is `currentColor`, so a diagram follows its page. |
| `accent` | Colour that points and never carries: six roles are coloured, and every one of them already differed from its neighbours by weight, dash or shape. |
| `wheel` | The broad tapered cycle connector — `[cycle] connector = "band"` — for a cycle drawn loudly. |
